subject: Sprintly onboarding — PO exception for pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Reed <procurement@sprintly.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@sprintly.io>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprintly onboarding — pilot invoice & PO question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo today — team is excited to kick off the 30-day pilot. One quick procurement ask: Sprintly typically requires a PO for vendor invoices, but for small pilots we sometimes do vendor exceptions and pay via standard invoice (Net 30).

Can Redwood accept an invoice without an official PO for the pilot run (estimated first invoice ~ $3,200)? If an exception is possible we can provide a signed W9 and a contact for ACH.

I've attached our W9 and the initial invoice stub for reference.

Attachments: Sprintly_W9.pdf, Sprintly_Initial_Invoice.pdf

Thanks,
Alyssa Reed
Procurement Manager
Sprintly
procurement@sprintly.io

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Reed <procurement@sprintly.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintly onboarding — pilot invoice & PO question

Hi Alyssa — appreciate the materials and quick turnaround.

Short answer: possible, but we need our procurement/finance team to sign off on a PO-exemption for pilot invoices under $5k and collect the usual compliance evidence. I've looped in Marissa (sales ops) and Laura (finance) to evaluate.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa / Laura: can you review the attached W9 and the invoice stub and confirm whether an exemption is OK for this pilot?
- Alyssa: if approved, can you confirm billing contact and whether Sprintly needs our vendor form completed? We also have a short PO Exemption Form to capture terms (payment net30, one-time pilot, no auto-renew).

I attached our standard PO_Exemption_Form_Fillable.pdf for ease.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_Exemption_Form_Fillable.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alyssa Reed <procurement@sprintly.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintly onboarding — pilot invoice & PO question

Thanks for the ping, Vivek — I reviewed the W9 and the invoice. Finance policy allows a case-by-case PO exemption for first-time pilots under $5k provided we get:

- Signed W9 and completed exemption form (one-off).
- Maximum pilot invoice capped at $5,000; any overage requires PO or re-approval.
- Payment terms: Net 30; Sprintly must acknowledge no auto-renew on the pilot invoice.
- Record retention: vendor evidence will be stored in our procurement folder for 7 years per policy.

I've filled sections 1–3 of the PO_Exemption_Form and added the approver block for Laura. Please see the notes in the form (attached).

Conditional approval: Laura, please can you confirm final sign-off from Finance?

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_Exemption_Form_Fillable.pdf (completed sections 1-3)
